description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search, calculated as the performance gap between VisuoThink with rollout search and VisuoThink without rollout search. The horizontal axis displays three model architectures: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", ranges from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating the percentage gain. For each model, two bars are grouped side-by-side: a hatched blue bar representing "Strong Supervision" and a solid blue bar representing "Weak Supervision". The bar for GPT-4o shows a strong supervision gain of approximately 25% and a weak supervision gain of approximately 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the strong supervision gain is approximately 10% and the weak supervision gain is approximately 4%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the strong supervision gain is approximately 15% and the weak supervision gain is approximately 6%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model architectures listed on the x-axis.
